title: Never below zero
prompt: Members `health` at 20. Write `take_damage`, which subtracts an amount and then, if health went below 0, sets it to 0. solve calls take_damage(50) and returns health, which is 0.
hints: Subtract first, then check the floor.

docs.name: var name = value (outside any function)
docs.what: A member variable: every function in the script can read and change it.
